summary: Iteration 26: verified Independence Festival Bonus, Referral Program (config, /me, SA stats + 403 for player), and Notifications endpoints. Backend pytest (7 new HTTP tests): 7/7 PASS. Frontend Playwright: Festival claim button rendered '+151 Coins', click credited bonus (toast + Gift Claimed state), state persisted after reload. Notification bell + panel opens and marks read. Refer & Earn opened from Wallet showing code, copy/WhatsApp/Share, You get 125 / They get 75, milestone nudge, and 5 referral history rows with status labels. Regression: Wallet loads with existing bonus tranches.

issues: Existing seeded referrals show referrer_reward=+200 in rows while current config referrer_amount=125. Rows use snapshotted historical reward (likely by design), but visually inconsistent with the '+125' promise in the hero. Consider clarifying or migrating.

action_items: Optional: clarify referrer_reward=200 on legacy referral rows vs current 125 config (either backfill or add 'legacy' badge).
Optional: seed at least one unread notification for player1 in demo so the bell badge/toast path is exercisable via UI without triggering a real referral qualification.
critical_code_review_comments: IndependenceBanner: correctly handles idempotency via disabled + optimistic state after claim; toast + confetti sparks fired.
NotificationBell: polls every 30s + toasts new referral_reward notifications on subsequent loads (skips first load unless referral_reward) — good UX; marks read on open.
ReferAndEarn hero renders CSS-uppercased 'Freedom to Play' — Playwright inner_text may return uppercased letters; not a functional bug.
Backend endpoints properly protected: /api/referrals/admin/stats returns 403 for PLAYER, 200 for SA.
seed_data_creation: Reset player1 festival claim state (deleted festival_claims + related bonus_grants) before UI test so 'Claim 151 Coins' shows fresh; player1 has now claimed again — reset again for next UI iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Player1's festival was claimed again during this UI run. To retest UI 'fresh' claim state, delete festival_claims for player1 and matching bonus_grants (see script in iter26 backend).
